transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, I'm here because things have been pretty stressful at my job lately. I'm a transportation inspector, and ever since I got this county safety award a while back, certain people at work have been... well, they've been twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking me these really pointed budget questions, like they're trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor keeps saying it's just a normal review process, but I mean, it's obvious to me. I can tell there's a coordinated effort going on to discredit me.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. No voices or visions or anything. I just see what's actually happening at work, you know? The emails, the way they question my reports... it's all right there in front of me. I'm not imagining things.
Have you had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually energetic or irritable and needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, I get a little frustrated or irritable sometimes just because of everything going on at the office with my reports, but my energy levels are pretty normal. I'm definitely sleeping my regular amount. I haven't had any days where I just didn't need sleep or felt super energetic, no.
Have you ever felt that people at work are deliberately plotting against you or trying to harm you in some way?

Yes, absolutely. Like I was saying earlier, it really started after I got that county safety award. It's not just a feeling, it's what they're actually doing. They take my inspection reports and they twist the facts around. And then they come at me with these really specific, pointed questions about the budget... it's like they're trying to trap me or make it look like I'm doing something crooked. My supervisor keeps telling me it's just a normal review, but I know what I'm seeing. It's a coordinated effort to ruin my reputation and discredit my work. They're definitely plotting against me.
Have you ever had beliefs or experiences that felt just as real to you but were about anything other than people at work plotting against you?

No, not really. It's just the stuff at work. I don't have any other strange ideas or anything like that. Everything else in my life is pretty normal, it's just this one situation with my reports and the people at the office. That's the only thing that's been going on.
Have these beliefs caused any problems with your work performance or daily functioning?

Well, yeah, it has caused some issues. I mean, the biggest consequence is probably just how tense things have gotten during my compliance reviews. And mentoring the younger inspectors, too—that used to be fine, but now it's just... uncomfortable. I've actually pulled back from a few coworkers I used to really trust. I just keep to myself a lot more now to avoid giving them anything else they can twist around. But outside of work, I'm functioning fine. It's really just those specific things on the job.
Do you think it’s possible that your coworkers’ actions could have a more ordinary explanation, or are you completely certain it’s a coordinated plot against you?

No, I don't see how there could be an ordinary explanation for this. I'm completely certain about what's happening. Like I said, I'm here because ever since I got that county safety award, certain people have been coming after me. They are actively twisting my inspection reports. And those pointed questions about the budget... they aren't just normal questions. They are specifically designed to try and make me look crooked. My supervisor keeps trying to brush it off, saying it's just a normal review process, but I know what's going on. I can tell there's a coordinated effort to discredit me and ruin my reputation. It's not a misunderstanding.
Have you ever had any experiences where it seemed like your thoughts were being controlled, inserted, or broadcast to other people?

No... no, nothing like that. My thoughts are my own. I've never felt like anyone was controlling my mind or reading my thoughts, or anything weird like that. It's just the actual, physical things they are doing at the office to set me up. That's it.
How long have you been convinced that your coworkers are plotting against you?

It's been going on for about a year now. Yeah, right around a year. It all started right after I got recognized for that county safety initiative I mentioned. That's when I first noticed things changing and they started coming after me.
Have you noticed any changes in your behavior or ability to take care of yourself that others have commented on?

No, not at all. I mean, I still get to work on time, I complete all my inspections... I keep up with church, and I take care of myself just fine. Nobody has said anything about me slipping up or acting different like that. 

The main problems really only come up when people bring up those reports, or when they question my spending. That's when things get tense. But as far as my day-to-day routine and taking care of myself? No, everything is completely normal.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people could not?
No, never. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I'm not crazy, doc. I just see what's actually happening right in front of me at work.
